full_prompt_en: A square minimal surreal photograph shows an almost empty field submerged in thick pale fog. At the lower center-left stands a very small dark human figure, seen from behind and facing into the mist. A short distance to the right, a larger stag stands as a softened charcoal silhouette. Its broad antlers rise above its head like delicate branching lines, and its four legs fade into the hazy ground. The ground itself is only a dark narrow band across the bottom quarter, with faint rough grass and small irregular shadows. Above it, a vast cream-to-gray fog field occupies most of the frame, carrying no discernible horizon, tree, building, or sky detail. Slight vignetting darkens the upper corners and lower edges, drawing attention toward the two separated forms. The stag appears strangely oversized beside the person, though the lack of depth cues keeps their exact relation uncertain. The light is diffuse and directionless, so neither form casts a defined shadow. Colors are almost monochrome: greenish gray, muted cream, soft charcoal, and an occasional cool blue tint in the darker ground. Fine photographic grain gives the smooth fog a subtle material presence. The composition leaves an enormous amount of negative space above the figures, making silence and distance feel physical. There is no action, text, or obvious narrative explanation. The mood is meditative and uncanny, as though a quiet encounter were suspended at the edge between familiar landscape and dream.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形极简超现实照片呈现一片几乎空白、浸没在厚浅雾中的田野。下方中央偏左立着极小深色人影，从背后看，面向雾里。稍靠右处一只更大的雄鹿呈柔化炭色剪影，宽鹿角像纤细分枝线升在头上，四腿逐渐融入雾地。地面只是下四分之一的一道深窄带，带微弱粗草和小片不规则暗影。其上大片奶油白至灰色雾场占画面大部，没有可辨地平线、树、建筑或天空细节。轻微暗角压暗上角与下缘，将目光带向两道分离形体。鹿在人旁显得异乎寻常地大，但缺少纵深线索使具体关系不确定。光漫散且无方向，因此双方都没有明确投影。颜色近乎单色：绿灰、低调奶油白、柔炭灰及深地面里偶尔冷蓝。细摄影颗粒让平滑雾有微妙实体感。人物上方留下巨大负空间，使沉默和距离几乎可触。没有动作、文字或明显叙事解释。氛围沉思而奇异，像一次安静相遇悬在熟悉风景与梦之间。
style_prompt_en: Use minimalist surreal photography built from immense pale atmospheric negative space and two or three small dark anchors near the bottom. Let thick fog erase the horizon and gradually soften every distant contour. Keep the palette nearly monochrome in cream, green-gray, charcoal, and faint cool blue. Apply gentle vignetting and fine grain to give the empty field depth without inserting detail. Place the small focal forms apart so scale and relationship remain quietly ambiguous. Lighting is diffuse and shadowless. The composition should feel still, meditative, and uncanny, deriving its tension from distance, disproportion, and what the mist conceals.
style_prompt_zh: 采用极简超现实摄影，以大片浅色大气负空间和靠近底部的两三处小深色锚点构图。厚雾擦去地平线，并逐步柔化所有远轮廓。色板近单色，使用奶油白、绿灰、炭灰和极淡冷蓝。轻暗角与细颗粒给空场以纵深，不额外塞入细节。小焦点形体彼此分开，使尺度与关系安静地保持模糊。光漫散而无影。构图应静止、沉思、奇异，张力来自距离、失衡比例以及雾所隐藏之处。
theme_en: A small person confronting a distant stag in an immense foggy field
theme_zh: 微小人影在广阔雾地中面对远处雄鹿
name: Martin Stranka
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
